wars.name: Carinthian plebiscite dispute
wars.outcome: Plebiscite of 10 October 1920: 'the majority chose to remain with Austria'; no land changed hands.

certainty.note: The republic claimed more than it kept until Saint-Germain was signed on 10 September 1919; South Tyrol was Italian-occupied.
Saint-Germain, the Carinthian plebiscite (10 October 1920) and Burgenland (1921) fixed the lines.
